Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The Children's Library will be temporarily closed due to facility repairs during the following period.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (all day)】

December 4, 2024 (Friday) through January 15, 2025 (Friday)

【What to know during the closure】

• You cannot browse materials, borrow books, or return books at the Children's Library.

• If you have reserved materials for pickup at the Children's Library, please pick them up at the Hanno City Library instead.

• The book return box will remain available during the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
